title: Upper bound for the field degree
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $b$ be positive integers with $2a\le b$, and define the scale $S=\lceil nb/a\rceil$ and field degree $D=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 S\rceil)$. Then $D+1\le 4(S+1)$.
